note: text = caption wording; say = what the TTS reads when pronunciation needs help. gapBefore = silence before a scene's first line; holdAfter = extra time after a line for the on-screen action to finish. All figures on screen are the demo school's data as the app computes it.

lines.text: End of semester.
Class tests, assignments, project work, exam scripts.
Every score copied into a mark book, added up and ranked by hand.
One slip, and a report card is wrong.
CAS takes every score straight to the report card.
lines.say: {CAS} takes every score straight to the report card.

lines.text: Set your continuous assessment once: class tests, assignments and project work, each with its weight.
Teachers see their own subjects and classes.
Try to submit too early, and CAS shows exactly what's missing.
lines.say: Try to submit too early, and {CAS} shows exactly what's missing.

lines.text: Here, the project work.
Add it in a few taps.
Type scores straight into the class list,
or upload the whole class from Excel.
Now every check passes.
Submit to the head of department.
The head of department sees every subject waiting for review.
Check the scores, then approve, or send it back with a reason.
The admin gives the final approval,
then publishes results for the school in one click.
Along the way, the Assessment Tracker shows every teacher's progress.
And Outstanding Submissions shows exactly who is still behind.
Report cards build themselves: CA, exam, total, grade and position for every subject.
Add the form teacher's remarks, and print the whole class at once.
Students see their report card the moment it's published,
with the class average beside every subject.
And every semester adds to the student's full transcript.
CAS. Comprehensive Academic Suite.
Scores in. Report cards out.
